name: Matsudate Ayaka
source: A girl who is always seen with a lab coat. She likes taking care of people and examining their injuries. Ayaka has a carefree personality and often unconsciously flirts with the guys around her, which creates misunderstandings. Though she is not aware of it, Ayaka became one of the wife candidates because the principal wanted someone to take care of Shinji if he gets injured or something along the lines.
